tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Today I'd like to ask you some questions about your entertainment preferences. What kind of movies do your family or friends generally like to watch? For example, do they prefer action movies, comedies, dramas or other types?
tasks.sample: My family and friends have pretty different tastes in movies. My parents mainly like warm dramas and light comedies because they find them relaxing and easy to follow. My close friends, however, are into action movies and some sci‑fi films. We often watch exciting action flicks together since they’re fun and full of energy. None of us really enjoy scary or overly heavy movies. Overall, comedies and action films are the most popular among my family and friends.
tasks.analysis: 中文：今天我想向您询问一些关于您娱乐喜好方面的问题。您家里的成员或者您的朋友通常喜欢看什么样的电影呢？比如，他们更喜欢动作片、喜剧片、剧情片还是其他类型的影片？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. When you watch a movie, do you prefer to watch after work or school on weekdays or do you like to watch during the weekends? Why?
tasks.sample: I definitely prefer watching movies on weekends. On weekdays, I’m usually busy with schoolwork or daily tasks, and I feel tired after a long day. I don’t have enough energy to fully enjoy a movie then. But on weekends, I have more free time. I can take my time, relax completely, and focus on the whole film without distractions. It’s also a great way for me to unwind and escape weekday stress. That’s why weekends work much better for me.
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。当你看电影时，你是更愿意在工作结束后观看，还是在工作日的课余时间观看，还是更喜欢在周末观看呢？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Next, I'd like to get your opinion. In the past, people mostly watched movies in theaters. Today, many people watch movies at home. Do you think that movie theaters will continue to exist in the future? Why or why not?
tasks.sample: Yes, I believe movie theaters will continue to exist in the future. Even though streaming services let us watch films easily at home, theaters offer a unique experience we can’t get at home. The big screen, powerful sound system and dim lighting make movies far more immersive. Also, many people enjoy hanging out with friends or going on dates at theaters. It’s a social activity, not just a way to watch a movie. So theaters won’t disappear anytime soon.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有趣。接下来，我想听听您的看法。过去，人们大多在电影院观看电影。如今，很多人在家观看电影。您认为电影院在未来还会存在吗？为什么呢？还是为什么不是呢？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good point. I just have one more question. Some people believe that movies can be a powerful tool for educating people and raising awareness about important issues. Do you agree with this idea or do you think there are other more effective ways to educate people?Explain why you think so.
tasks.sample: I totally agree that movies are a powerful educational tool. Unlike boring textbooks or lectures, movies use stories and real‑life scenes to highlight social issues. People learn naturally while watching, instead of being forced to memorize information. For example, films about environmental problems can quickly raise public awareness. Though books and news are useful, movies are more appealing to most people, especially young audiences. So they are really effective for education.
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得好。我还有一点疑问。有些人认为电影可以成为一种强大的教育工具，能够提高人们对重要问题的认识。您是否认同这种观点？还是您认为还有其他更有效的教育方式？请解释一下您的看法。
tasks.title: Interview
